messages:
clare.devex: heads-up — quickstart/README.md shows a curl example using `Authorization: Token $REDWOOD_API_KEY` and a Go snippet that also references `Token`. new hire hit a 401 during an onboarding exercise this morning.

raj.engineer: ouch. that header rename happened in v1.3, right? if samples still pin older SDKs they could be misleading. any specific files pinned to 1.2?

clare.devex: yep: samples/go/go.mod has `redwood v1.2.0` and python/requirements.txt pins `redwood-sdk==1.2.0`. README meanwhile mentions streaming shapes that are v1.4+. basically a copy/paste drift nightmare.

anya.docs: proposed README fix: replace header with `Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY` and add a small "Common pitfalls" callout for the header rename and streaming API change. will also add the exact error text so support searches surface this quickly.

raj.engineer: add a lightweight smoke test: `tests/smoke.sh` that POSTs the curl to a local stub which returns 200 for Bearer and 401 for Token. GH Action `smoke-check` can run it on PRs to catch regressions.

ci-bot: PR #678 created by anya.docs — CI queued. :gear:

anya.docs: PR includes README updates, bump in go.mod and requirements to `>=1.4.0`, `tests/smoke.sh`, and a GH Action job. also added an example error snippet in README: "{\"error\":\"unauthorized\", \"message\":\"invalid auth header\"}" for quick lookup.

clare.devex: great. please add one line to samples/CHANGES.md and the onboarding checklist so we remind mentors to verify sample deps before cohorts. tiny friction but big ROI.

raj.engineer: merged after CI went green. cut samples v0.5.0 and posted migration note in #onboarding.

clare.devex: closing the loop — next cohort zero curl-auth 401s. nice win. :tada:
